tables.table_description: The `stg_dbt_runs` table stores detailed information about job runs in the dbt Cloud platform, including identifiers, statuses, timestamps, durations, execution context, and associated metadata.

columns.name: id
columns.column_description: Unique identifier for a job run in the dbt Cloud platform.

columns.name: trigger_id
columns.column_description: Identifier for the trigger that initiated the job run.

columns.name: account_id
columns.column_description: The `account_id` column stores the integer identifier for the account associated with a dbt run.

columns.name: environment_id
columns.column_description: Identifier for the environment associated with a specific job run.

columns.name: project_id
columns.column_description: The `project_id` column stores the integer identifier of the project associated with a specific dbt Cloud job run.

columns.name: job_definition_id
columns.column_description: Identifier for the job definition associated with a specific run.

columns.name: status
columns.column_description: Indicates the current state of a job run using an integer-based status code.

columns.name: dbt_version
columns.column_description: The `dbt_version` column stores the version of dbt used for a specific job run.

columns.name: git_branch
columns.column_description: The `git_branch` column stores the name of the Git branch associated with a specific dbt job run.

columns.name: git_sha
columns.column_description: The `git_sha` column stores the Git commit hash associated with a specific dbt Cloud job run.

columns.name: status_message
columns.column_description: The `status_message` column stores a string describing the current status or outcome of a job run in dbt Cloud.

columns.name: owner_thread_id
columns.column_description: Identifier for the thread associated with the owner of a specific job run.

columns.name: executed_by_thread_id
columns.column_description: Identifier of the thread that executed the run, used for tracking execution context.

columns.name: deferring_run_id
columns.column_description: Identifier of the preceding run that this run defers to, if applicable.

columns.name: artifacts_saved
columns.column_description: Indicates whether artifacts were successfully saved for a specific job run.

columns.name: artifact_s3_path
columns.column_description: The `artifact_s3_path` column stores the S3 path location of artifacts generated during a dbt Cloud job run.

columns.name: has_docs_generated
columns.column_description: Indicates whether documentation was successfully generated for the job run.

columns.name: has_sources_generated
columns.column_description: Indicates whether sources were generated during the dbt run.

columns.name: notifications_sent
columns.column_description: Indicates whether notifications have been sent for a specific job run.

columns.name: blocked_by
columns.column_description: Indicates the ID of another job run that is blocking the execution of the current job run.

columns.name: created_at
columns.column_description: Timestamp indicating when the run record was created.

columns.name: updated_at
columns.column_description: Timestamp indicating the last update to the job run record.

columns.name: dequeued_at
columns.column_description: The `dequeued_at` column records the timestamp when a job run was dequeued, stored as a string.

columns.name: started_at
columns.column_description: Timestamp indicating when the job run started, stored as a string.

columns.name: finished_at
columns.column_description: The `finished_at` column records the timestamp when a job run was completed, stored as a string.

columns.name: last_checked_at
columns.column_description: Timestamp indicating the last time the run's status was checked.

columns.name: last_heartbeat_at
columns.column_description: Timestamp of the most recent heartbeat signal for a job run, indicating its active status.

columns.name: should_start_at
columns.column_description: The `should_start_at` column stores the scheduled start time for a job run in text format.

columns.name: trigger
columns.column_description: Indicates the method or source that initiated the dbt job run.

columns.name: job
columns.column_description: The job column stores the name or identifier of the job associated with a specific run in dbt Cloud.

columns.name: environment
columns.column_description: The "environment" column stores the name or identifier of the environment associated with a specific dbt Cloud job run.

columns.name: run_steps
columns.column_description: Contains a serialized representation of the steps executed within a specific dbt job run.

columns.name: deprecation
columns.column_description: Indicates whether the run is associated with deprecated features or configurations.

columns.name: status_humanized
columns.column_description: Human-readable representation of the job run's status.

columns.name: in_progress
columns.column_description: Indicates whether a job run is currently in progress.

columns.name: is_complete
columns.column_description: Indicates whether a job run has completed successfully or unsuccessfully.

columns.name: is_success
columns.column_description: Indicates whether a job run was successful.

columns.name: is_error
columns.column_description: Indicates whether the job run encountered an error (true) or completed without errors (false).

columns.name: is_cancelled
columns.column_description: Indicates whether a job run was cancelled.

columns.name: duration
columns.column_description: The duration column stores the runtime duration of a job run as a string.

columns.name: queued_duration
columns.column_description: The `queued_duration` column stores the duration of time a job run spent in the queued state, represented as a string.

columns.name: run_duration
columns.column_description: The `run_duration` column stores the duration of a job run as a string.

columns.name: duration_humanized
columns.column_description: Human-readable representation of the job run duration.

columns.name: queued_duration_humanized
columns.column_description: The `queued_duration_humanized` column stores the human-readable string representation of the duration a job run spent in the queued state.

columns.name: run_duration_humanized
columns.column_description: Human-readable representation of the run duration.

columns.name: created_at_humanized
columns.column_description: Human-readable string representation of the job run's creation timestamp.

columns.name: finished_at_humanized
columns.column_description: Human-readable timestamp indicating when a job run finished.

columns.name: retrying_run_id
columns.column_description: Identifier of the original run being retried, if applicable.

columns.name: can_retry
columns.column_description: Indicates whether a job run can be retried.

columns.name: retry_not_supported_reason
columns.column_description: Indicates the reason why a job run cannot be retried, if applicable.

columns.name: job_id
columns.column_description: The `job_id` column stores the integer identifier of the job associated with a specific run.

columns.name: is_running
columns.column_description: Indicates whether a job run is currently in progress.

columns.name: href
columns.column_description: The `href` column stores the URL link to access detailed information about a specific job run.

columns.name: used_repo_cache
columns.column_description: Indicates whether the repository cache was used during the job run.

columns.name: audit
columns.column_description: Indicates whether the run is an audit run, providing context for its purpose within the job orchestration process.

tables.table_description: The `stg_dbt_run_steps` table captures detailed information about individual steps within a dbt Cloud job run, including identifiers, execution status, logs, timestamps, commands, and structured debug data.

columns.name: id
columns.column_description: Unique identifier for a run step within the dbt Cloud job orchestration platform.

columns.name: run_id
columns.column_description: Unique identifier for the run associated with the step.

columns.name: account_id
columns.column_description: The `account_id` column stores the integer identifier for the account associated with a specific run step.

columns.name: index
columns.column_description: The "index" column stores the sequential position of a step within a job run, represented as an integer.

columns.name: status
columns.column_description: The `status` column stores an integer representing the execution state of a run step within the dbt Cloud job orchestration process.

columns.name: name
columns.column_description: The "name" column stores the descriptive name of a specific run step within the dbt Cloud job orchestration process.

columns.name: logs
columns.column_description: Contains the log output generated during the execution of a specific run step.

columns.name: debug_logs
columns.column_description: Stores debug log output generated during the execution of a specific run step.

columns.name: log_path
columns.column_description: Path to the log file associated with a specific run step.

columns.name: debug_log_path
columns.column_description: Path to the debug log file associated with a specific run step.

columns.name: truncated_debug_logs
columns.column_description: Stores a shortened version of debug logs generated during a specific run step.

columns.name: structured_logs_path
columns.column_description: Path to the structured logs file associated with a specific run step.

columns.name: structured_logs
columns.column_description: Stores detailed log data in a structured text format for individual run steps.

columns.name: structured_debug_logs_path
columns.column_description: Path to the structured debug logs associated with a specific run step.

columns.name: structured_debug_logs
columns.column_description: Contains structured debug log data in text format for a specific run step.

columns.name: truncated_structured_debug_logs
columns.column_description: Contains a truncated version of the structured debug logs generated during a run step.

columns.name: started_at
columns.column_description: Timestamp indicating when the run step started, stored as a string.

columns.name: finished_at
columns.column_description: Timestamp indicating when the run step was completed.

columns.name: status_color
columns.column_description: Indicates the color-coded status of a run step for visual representation in the dbt Cloud interface.

columns.name: status_humanized
columns.column_description: Human-readable description of the run step's status.

columns.name: duration
columns.column_description: The `duration` column stores the runtime duration of a specific job run step as a string.

columns.name: duration_humanized
columns.column_description: The `duration_humanized` column stores the human-readable representation of the duration for a run step in the dbt Cloud job orchestration platform.

columns.name: created_at
columns.column_description: Timestamp indicating when the run step record was created.

columns.name: updated_at
columns.column_description: Timestamp indicating when the run step record was last updated.

columns.name: run_step_command
columns.column_description: The `run_step_command` column stores the text of the command executed for a specific step within a dbt Cloud job run.

columns.name: run_step_invocation
columns.column_description: The `run_step_invocation` column stores text details about the invocation context or command executed for a specific run step in the dbt Cloud job orchestration process.

tables.table_description: Table storing paths to artifact files generated during dbt job runs.

columns.name: artifact_path
columns.column_description: Path to the artifact file generated during a dbt job run.

tables.table_description: One row per model execution parsed from dbt step logs. Each row captures the model name, schema, materialization type, execution status (succeeded/errored/skipped), duration in seconds, and Snowflake error code and message when the model failed. Foreign keys to stg_dbt_run_steps and stg_dbt_runs.

columns.name: step_id
columns.column_description: Foreign key to stg_dbt_run_steps.id — the step whose log produced this result.

columns.name: model_schema
columns.column_description: Snowflake target schema the model was materialized into (e.g. DBT_PROD, DBT_PROD_enriched).

columns.name: model_name
columns.column_description: Name of the dbt model (e.g. vw_FactSales, DimCustomer).

columns.name: run_id
columns.column_description: Foreign key to stg_dbt_runs.id — the run that contained this step.

columns.name: account_id
columns.column_description: dbt Cloud account identifier.

columns.name: model_type
columns.column_description: dbt materialization type: view, incremental, or table.

columns.name: status
columns.column_description: Execution outcome: succeeded, errored, or skipped.

columns.name: duration_s
columns.column_description: Wall-clock execution time in seconds as reported in the step log.

columns.name: error_code
columns.column_description: dbt error code (e.g. dbt1302) extracted from the ERROR block. Null when status is succeeded or skipped.

columns.name: error_message
columns.column_description: Snowflake error detail extracted from the ERROR block. Null when status is succeeded or skipped.
